meta.name: competitive-research-snapshot
meta.description: Research a competitive landscape with cited snapshots, a comparison matrix, and so-what implications. Use when a product decision needs competitive grounding, not a market report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速生成竞品对比矩阵与行动建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做产品决策前需要快速了解竞品格局
copy.tagline_en: Generate competitive comparison matrix and actionable insights quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick competitive grounding before product decisions

howto.what: Claude 会按流程搜索竞品、选择3-4个对手、用事实/推断/假设标签记录信息，并输出带引用来源的对比矩阵和决策建议。
howto.when: 当你需要为产品决策（如定位、路线图）寻找竞品证据，而不是写市场报告时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一份竞品快照，决策是下季度的路线图优先级。
say.note: Claude 会先问3个问题，然后输出结构化报告。

say.text: 研究我们的费用自动化产品，对手是A和B，再找一个。
say.note: Claude 会按你给的对手开始研究。

howto.what_en: Claude runs a workflow: search plan, competitor selection, research with Fact/Inference/Assumption labels, real URL citations, and outputs a comparison matrix and decision implications.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need competitive evidence for a product decision (e.g., positioning, roadmap), not a full market report.

say_en.text: Run a competitive snapshot for our expense automation product, decision: Q1 roadmap bet.
say_en.note: Claude asks up to 3 questions then produces the snapshot.

say_en.text: Research competitors A and B, find a third if needed.
say_en.note: Claude uses your provided competitors and identifies one more.
